room.hall.title: Hall
room.hall.description: A bare hall with a stone [stand](stand). A crypt lies east.
room.crypt.title: Crypt
room.crypt.description: A cold crypt, its walls lined with niches.
npc.wight.description: A pale wight. Fire only half burns it.
room.crypt.dark: It is pitch dark. Something breathes nearby.
item.orb.room: A glass [orb] rests on a stand.
item.orb.description: A glass orb that holds a spell's light.
item.glowdust.description: Fine dust that feeds the orb.
narration.lux: You speak lux; light wells up in the orb.
narration.flamma: A bolt of fire leaps from your hand.
narration.ward: You speak the word of warding.
